description: This file contains the implementation of the SymBool class and its methods, used for symbolic boolean reasoning in the c10 namespace. It defines logical operations, conversions, and guards related to symbolic boolean expressions.

classes.name: SymBool
classes.description: A class representing symbolic boolean values, supporting logical operations, conversions, and safety guards.

methods.name: SymNode toSymNodeImpl() const
methods.description: Converts the SymBool to its underlying SymNode representation, ensuring it is heap allocated.

methods.name: SymNode wrap_node(const SymNode & base) const
methods.description: Wraps a base SymNode with the current SymBool state, or returns the SymNode representation.

methods.name: sym_and
methods.description: Performs logical AND between two SymBool instances.

methods.name: sym_or
methods.description: Performs logical OR between two SymBool instances.

methods.name: sym_not
methods.description: Returns the logical negation of the SymBool.

methods.name: bool guard_bool(const char * file,int64_t line) const
methods.description: Ensures the SymBool is concretely true or false, with file and line info.

methods.name: bool guard_size_oblivious(const char * file,int64_t line) const
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool guard is size-oblivious, with file and line info.

methods.name: bool guard_or_false(const char * file,int64_t line) const
methods.description: Guards the SymBool, returning false if unconstrained.

methods.name: bool statically_known_true(const char * file,int64_t line) const
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool is statically known to be true.

methods.name: bool guard_or_true(const char * file,int64_t line) const
methods.description: Guards the SymBool, returning true if unconstrained.

methods.name: bool expect_true(const char * file,int64_t line) const
methods.description: Asserts that the SymBool is expected to be true.

methods.name: bool has_hint() const
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool has an associated hint.

methods.name: SymInt toSymInt() const
methods.description: Converts the SymBool to a symbolic integer, representing true as 1 and false as 0.
